title: Ship a status widget that renders cyclotron-status/v1 as a strip or a card
description:
An embeddable view of what the cyclotron is doing now (export path cyclotron/components/cyclotron-status). Props: status (cyclotron-status/v1), variant 'strip'|'card', onOverride?. Strip example: Version 13 · agrees 86% · says 84% sure, right 86% · reviewing 1 in 4: audit accuracy met target. Card adds precision, recall, the calibration curve, the last change, and the override control. No backend client; ClassifierMetrics keeps working for the console. Ordering: after the status shape and the review-rate program.

Acceptance criteria:
- Renders from a fixture snapshot with no network; empty and onboarding states read sensibly.
- Shows the review rate, its reason, and any override with its expiry.
- Calibration is shown as says-sure versus is-right with the gap in points; Brier and ECE do not appear.
- Vitest covers strip, card, empty and override states.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on feat/status-widget (stacked on feat/review-control): trace-ui/src/components/cyclotron-status.tsx (CyclotronStatusView, variant strip or card, onOverride), exported as cyclotron/components/cyclotron-status, and the type as cyclotron/cyclotron-status. Recall, precision and accuracy carry the glossary subtitles; calibration reads 'Says N%, right M%' with the gap in points; the review rate shows state (mark and word), rate, reason, override with setter and expiry, next step and weekly reviews; last change reads as a version change, a minor refit, or a dropped candidate. Unmeasured values say 'Not measured yet'. Styles in styles/shared.css. 7 Vitest specs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan's copy notes landed on feat/widget-copy: the strip reads 'Tapering · 25% reviewed' (the full sentence stays in the card and the strip's tooltip); the card title takes a classifierName prop and falls back to the classifier id.
